description: A core font pack per platform and OS release, plus optional packs the seed includes one by one. A page sees only the families in the drawn packs that are also installed on the host; `requires.families` names what the host has to install.

options.note: Stock Windows 11 families: the Windows 11 English release font set intersected with the MauCariApa-com/windows-11-fonts repo, plus Marlett. The repo does not ship Marlett, so a host without it simply does not show it. "Franklin Gothic" is listed beside "Franklin Gothic Medium" because Windows answers both names with that face. Every stock family is here: handwriting, supplemental and historic scripts and CJK Extension B ship with every install and a missing one marks the list as edited. Profiles differ by the optional packs that real machines differ by.
Families Microsoft Office desktop installs that Windows does not ship. Authored prevalence: a little over half of Windows desktops have Office. A page sees them only where the host has Office.
